continuity: Minwoo and roughly eight hundred Hunters are fighting the fanatics in the canyon; a powerful Arab fanatic has targeted Minwoo, and the Skeleton King has engaged him.
The battle’s shock caused small cracks in the canyon, helping free the Doppelganger.
The Doppelganger has completed its 145th resurrection and is still regenerating after Jin’s attacks.
Jin defeated Level 78 Brody Woods and leveled up; Fatigue and Muscle Pain were removed, internal energy began recovering, but the Broken Body debuff rejected the healing power.
plot: Choi Minwoo leads roughly eight hundred Hunters into the canyon to meet the fanatics. Their charge breaks through the undead line; an old fanatic commander cuts down Minwoo’s griffin, but Minwoo and the Hunters leap clear and join the fight. A powerful Arab fanatic recognizes Minwoo as Sky’s blood and attacks him. The Skeleton King intervenes, and the battle’s shock fractures the canyon walls.

The cracks help free the trapped Doppelganger. Jin Taekyung kills Brody Woods, whose death triggers a Level Up that removes Jin’s Fatigue and Muscle Pain and restores some internal energy, though the Broken Body debuff rejects the healing power. Jin keeps fighting the Doppelganger, which completes its 145th resurrection and continues to regenerate.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is the World Hunter Federation’s Alliance Leader and pursues Main Quest [Cataclysm], which requires him to eliminate The Prophet within an unspecified time limit.
The Prophet is a Level 170 Doppelganger titled “The Final Abyss” and concealed itself for decades, including under the name Muninn.
The Prophet can revive by drawing on victims’ lives and can reproduce their appearances, abilities, and memories.
The Doppelganger has completed its 145th resurrection and continues to regenerate after Jin’s attacks.
The canyon battle between the Hunters and the fanatics is ongoing; roughly eight hundred Hunters are fighting, and the Skeleton King is engaged with a powerful Arab fanatic who targeted Choi Minwoo.
Jin killed Brody Woods, triggering a Level Up that removed Fatigue and Muscle Pain and began restoring internal energy; the Broken Body debuff rejected the healing power.
Magic Johnson says he helped Jin because they are friends; whether Johnson is human remains uncertain.
open_questions: Why does The Prophet want Jin to flee, and what does it ultimately want?
